sentences.en: Patients often die simply because they yield to their diseases.
sentences.zh: 病人往往因为屈服于疾病而死去。

sentences.en: The business will yield a fair return on the investment.
sentences.zh: 这笔生意将为投资带来合理的回报。

sentences.en: I'd rather die than yield to this sort of demand.
sentences.zh: 我宁死也不愿接受这种要求。

senses.zh: 出产，屈服，投降，弯下去，凹下去
